title: Sharing of resources and devolution
quote: 16th Finance Commission shifts transfers from entitlement to performance

boxes.title: Finance Commission (Art. 280)
items: Qualifications: **FC (Misc. Provisions) Act, 1951**; report before Parliament (**Art. 281**)
**280(3)(a)**: share net tax proceeds - vertical + horizontal
Not its job: ==maintaining income & expenditure accounts== (APPSC-G2 2017); not GST, cesses

boxes.title: Divisible pool & grants data
items: Pool share of gross tax: **89.2% → 82.1% → 78.3%** (FC-13 to 15) = =="41% illusion"==
16th Finance Commission grants **₹9.47 lakh crore**; only local body (**₹7.91 lakh crore**) + disaster

boxes.title: AP angle
items: FC grants **₹62,188 crore** of ₹1,04,493 crore (2025-26 RE)
Rural LB **₹16,627 crore**, urban LB **₹12,158 crore**, disaster **₹6,125 crore**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Sequence **42 → 41 → 41**: cut came at ==15th Finance Commission==, not 16th
Art. 275 grants charged on CFI (true); Art. 282 needs FC (false)
16th Finance Commission: tax effort (**2.5%**) dropped for GDP (**10%**) → rewards size, not need
Formula transfers ended with **NITI Aayog (1 Jan 2015)**
